video.title: AI欧腐《乖孩子别和吸血鬼睡/Good boys don't sleep with vampires》
video.desc:
After losing his parents, Theo has spent ten years trapped inside the powerful Hawthorne family, controlled by his uncle Victor and bullied by his cousin Mason—all while playing the role of the obedient “good boy.” But at Mason’s engagement party, Theo shocks everyone by destroying a family portrait and boldly propositioning Lucien, a dangerously powerful vampire.
What begins as a reckless one-night stand becomes Theo’s first real taste of freedom. Unlike his family, Lucien stops when Theo says stop, waits when Theo says wait, and gives him the power to fight back on his own terms. As Theo turns from secret rebellion to open defiance, buried family secrets begin to surface—and his relationship with Lucien becomes far more than a convenient alliance.
Just when Theo finally chooses his own future, an ancient vampire enemy arrives, threatening the one thing Lucien has never had before: someone he is truly afraid to lose. 
父母去世后，Theo 被困在权势显赫的 Hawthorne 家族整整十年。他受叔叔 Victor 控制，被堂兄 Mason 欺凌，却始终扮演着那个听话顺从的“乖孩子”。
然而，在 Mason 的订婚宴上，Theo 做出了震惊所有人的举动——他毁掉了一幅家族肖像，还大胆地向一位危险而强大的吸血鬼 Lucien 发出邀请。
一场不顾后果的一夜情，却让 Theo 第一次真正尝到了自由的滋味。Lucien 与他的家人截然不同：Theo 说停，他就停；Theo 说等，他便等。他把选择权交还给 Theo，让 Theo 能够按照自己的意愿反抗。
随着 Theo 从暗中的叛逆一步步走向公开对抗，被掩埋多年的家族秘密也开始浮出水面。而他与 Lucien 的关系，也逐渐变得远不止一场各取所需的结盟。
就在 Theo 终于决定选择属于自己的未来时，一个古老的吸血鬼仇敌突然现身，威胁到了 Lucien 从未拥有过的珍贵之物——一个真正让他害怕失去的人。
